ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Milk souring
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Water.

3. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. joule (J)
   C. watt (W)
   D. newton (N)

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Harmful effects of? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Harmful effects of.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Harmful effects of.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Harmful effects of.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Harmful effects of.

5. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping home? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping home.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping home.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping home.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping home.

7. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Removing all vegetation

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Energy resources.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and Sky its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and Sky its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and Sky its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and Sky its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Sky its resources.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Soil its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil its resources.

11. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Primary consumers only

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of water? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of water.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of water.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of water.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of water.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Plants its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants its resources.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.

15. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Heating until a solid melts

16. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 50 °C

17. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

18. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Exploring weather? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Exploring weather.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Exploring weather.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Exploring weather.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Exploring weather.

20. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sounds that alert us? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sounds that alert us.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sounds that alert us.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sounds that alert us.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Sounds that alert us.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for plants environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for animals environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Managing waste environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Safety in handling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for water environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Conserving Light environment School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and Sky its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Exploring weather and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
